description: Prototype scope labels and boundary rules. These labels support source classification but do not constitute regulatory certification.

organizational_boundaries.name: Operational control
organizational_boundaries.description: Include operations where the company has authority to introduce and implement operating policies.

organizational_boundaries.name: Financial control
organizational_boundaries.description: Include operations where the company directs financial and operating policies with a view to gaining economic benefits.

organizational_boundaries.name: Equity share
organizational_boundaries.description: Account for emissions according to the company's share of equity in an operation. Not implemented by the simple MVP calculation path.

scopes.name: Scope 1
scopes.description: Direct greenhouse-gas emissions from sources owned or controlled by the reporting company.

scopes.name: Scope 2
scopes.description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity, steam, heat or cooling consumed by the reporting company.

scopes.name: Scope 3
scopes.description: Other indirect value-chain emissions. The prototype includes selected categories only and must label the inventory as partial.

selected_scope_3_categories.name: Fuel- and energy-related activities not included in Scope 1 or Scope 2

classification_rules.description: Owned or operationally controlled stationary and mobile combustion is Scope 1.
Purchased electricity, heat, steam and cooling consumed by the facility is Scope 2.
Third-party activity outside organizational control is retained as a value-chain candidate and mapped to an included Scope 3 category only after review.
